answer.en: Yes, in small amounts. All kinds of cabbage are fine for dogs, but cabbage makes a lot of gas, so introduce it slowly. Boiled or steamed cabbage is less likely to upset the stomach than raw cabbage.
answer.sl: Da, v majhnih količinah. Vse vrste zelja so za pse v redu, vendar zelje povzroča veliko vetrov, zato ga uvajajte postopoma. Kuhano ali na pari pripravljeno zelje manj verjetno razdraži prebavo kot surovo.

why.en: Cabbage is healthy for dogs, but it produces a large amount of gas, and many dogs may not handle that well. Seasonings are the bigger problem: butter and other fatty foods can lead to pancreatitis, and onions and garlic are toxic to dogs.
why.sl: Zelje je za pse zdravo, vendar povzroča veliko vetrov, česar mnogi psi ne prenašajo dobro. Večja težava so dodatki: maslo in druga mastna hrana lahko povzročita vnetje trebušne slinavke, čebula in česen pa sta za pse strupena.

what_to_do.en: Watch your dog closely after the first taste of cabbage. If your dog tends to have a lot of gas or is prone to bloat, ask your vet before giving cabbage.
what_to_do.sl: Po prvem okušanju zelja psa pozorno opazujte. Če ima pes pogosto veliko vetrov ali je nagnjen k napihnjenosti, se pred tem posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: Washed, with the stem and core removed, boiled or steamed, and diced into small pieces. Unseasoned: no butter, onion or garlic. Small amounts only.
serving.sl: Oprano, brez stebla in kocena, kuhano ali pripravljeno na pari in narezano na majhne koščke. Brez dodatkov: brez masla, čebule in česna. Le v majhnih količinah.

child.en: Dogs can try a little plain cooked cabbage. It can make them windy, so just a small piece!
child.sl: Psi lahko poskusijo malo navadnega kuhanega zelja. Lahko jim povzroči vetrove, zato le majhen košček!

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo surovo zelje?

a.en: They can, but boiled or steamed cabbage is less likely to upset a dog's digestion. Dice it into small pieces either way.
a.sl: Lahko, vendar kuhano ali na pari pripravljeno zelje manj verjetno razdraži pasjo prebavo. V vsakem primeru ga narežite na majhne koščke.

sources.quote: It’s okay to give your dog some cabbage in small quantities, but there are some precautions you should be aware of.
so it is safe to feed a dog cabbage, but only in moderation.

consult with your vet before feeding cabbage to your dog.
